workshop.vfx.scene.M5AdversarialTest:Stateless frames (cancellation is the caller's): evaluation order does not matter; a stopped effect is one the caller no longer evaluates; BEFORE, ACTIVE-but-empty and AFTER (ended) are distinct
workshop.vfx.scene.M5BoundaryTest:API shape: exactly the ten public types of contract section 2 with exactly their public members; final classes without public constructors

workshop.vfx.scene.M5BoundaryTest:Forbidden calls: no Math trigonometry, pow, exp, log, hypot, fma or random (StrictMath sin and cos only); no clocks, threads, synchronization, Random, System.out or mutable static fields
workshop.vfx.scene.M5BoundaryTest:Imports: only workshop.vfx.math.core, .time, .curve, .sample and java.util; never Bukkit, Paper, Minecraft, java.io, java.nio, java.net, threads or reflection
workshop.vfx.scene.M5DeterminismTest:Repetition: 25 rounds over the four example scenes at 15 instants give bit-identical frames (including through JIT compilation)
workshop.vfx.scene.M5DeterminismTest:Threads: 8 threads evaluating the same scene objects concurrently produce the single-threaded frames
workshop.vfx.scene.SceneValidationTest:EffectScene.evaluate: null anchor, playback or instant gives IllegalArgumentException

workshop.vfx.scene.SceneValidationTest:EffectScene.of: nonnull domain, limits and layers; lifetime > 0 (finite or UNBOUNDED); unique layer names; layer and point counts within the limits; empty scenes allowed; the list is copied and unmodifiable
workshop.vfx.scene.SceneValidationTest:Layer: name [a-z0-9_.-]{1,64}; every component nonnull

workshop.vfx.scene.SceneValidationTest:Motion: spin axis finite with largest component >= 1e-12, |turns| <= 2^20, finite phase; scales in [1e-9, 1e9]; finite translations; nonnull drives and easings; at most 16 steps
workshop.vfx.scene.SceneValidationTest:SceneLimits: 1 <= maxLayers <= 4096 and 1 <= maxPointsPerFrame <= 2^20
workshop.vfx.scene.SceneValidationTest:Shape: finite nonnull points, at most 2^20; 0 points allowed; the input list is copied

workshop.vfx.scene.SceneValidationTest:StyleKey: namespace [a-z0-9_.-]{1,32}, one colon, path [a-z0-9_./-]{1,64}; anything else (null, empty parts, upper case, spaces, two colons, slash in the namespace, overlong parts) is rejected
workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:Domains: the playback anchor and the instant must both have the scene's domain (IllegalArgumentException), GAME and COSMETIC alike

workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:Extreme instants: GAME tick differences that overflow long give ArithmeticException (M2); COSMETIC nanoseconds wrap (M2); non-finite local ticks give ArithmeticException; huge finite local ticks are evaluated

workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:Layer passes are half-open (M2): visible at the start, still at nextDown(end), hidden at the end for ACTIVE_ONLY, held at progress 1 for HOLD_AFTER; hidden before a delay
workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:Ping-pong and loops: cycle and progress are M2's; a held ping-pong with an even cycle count ends at progress 0
workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:Playback controls are M2's: paused frames do not change; seek moves; negative rate plays backwards; zero rate freezes; restart and resume

workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:Scene window: local < 0 is BEFORE (empty), [0, lifetime) is ACTIVE, local >= lifetime is AFTER (empty, even with HOLD_AFTER layers); UNBOUNDED never ends; -0.0 counts as 0
workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:Signed zero: local ticks of -0.0 are reported as +0.0 and evaluated as the scene start
workshop.vfx.scene.TimeSemanticsTest:The frame reports the playback's local ticks exactly (M2 Playback.localTicks)
